name: Autoblow AI Ultra
summary: Motorized vertical-grip oral simulator trained on machine-learning technique timing profiles with replaceable sleeves and optional VR script connectivity.
ranking_rationale: Delivers uniquely varied tempo and rhythm modes out of the box without needing external scripts; kept out of top tier by size, noise, and wall-power constraints.

pricing.free_tier: Standalone modes work without any app or subscription
pricing.notes: Check official Autoblow store for current pricing and sleeve packs.

pros: Variable rhythm & tempo programs require zero app setup or phone pairing
Interchangeable internal grip sleeves adjust texture and tightness
Strong vertical-motion motor handles longer sessions without stalling
cons: Large desktop footprint that lacks discretion for travel
Mechanical drive noise is noticeable outside closed-back headphones

image.alt: Autoblow AI Ultra logo and brand card

facts.value: Pre-programmed variable oral-simulation tempo profiles plus manual control
Detachable top collar and washable interchangeable sleeves
